summary: This Dockerfile creates a lightweight Python container running a FastAPI application. It starts with a minimal Python image, installs FastAPI, copies your application code into the container, and configures it to run on port 82.

explanations.2: The 'slim' variant is a smaller version of Python that includes only essential packages, making your final container image smaller and faster to download.
explanations.8: The --no-cache-dir flag tells pip not to store downloaded package files after installation, which saves space in the final image since we won't need to reinstall these packages.
explanations.11: This copies main.py from your computer into the container at the /app directory (which we set as WORKDIR), so the container can access your application code.
explanations.14: CMD specifies the default command that runs when the container starts — in this case, it launches FastAPI with your main.py script and makes it listen on port 82 instead of the default port 8000.
